Name: Rūna
Description: Runa was created by writers Jason Aaron and Torunn Gronbekk, designed by Mattia de Iulis and first appeared in King In Black: Return of the Valkyries #1. The inspiration for the character appears to be the Marvel Cinematic Universe's version of Valkyrie, portrayed by Tessa Thompson.
